answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering. Each agent’s action sequence passes through a shared inlet of timing and phrasing features, which are hashed into per-session vectors. After the fact, the system fits a mixture model; clusters tighter than a marble-sized tolerance are flagged as one operator. To forge distinct identities, an attacker must vary timing, lexicon, and tool-call order per account, raising the marginal cost of each convincing persona to sustained manual curation rather than cheap scripted duplication.
